info.title: OpenMayhem API
info.description: Pay-per-use AI inference over a decentralised provider network. OpenAI-compatible where an equivalent exists. Billing is reserve-then-settle from prepaid credit; every charge settles against a provider-signed receipt. Human docs: https://openmayhem.ai/docs (each page also at /docs/<slug>.md).

post.description: OpenAI-compatible. Requires the CHAT scope. Streaming defaults to off; explicit stream: true enables progressive server-sent events (SSE). The API forwards emitted deltas without buffering the entire output; a provider backend may buffer its own output rather than emit token by token. Native Core durable jobs preserve billing and reconciliation. Disconnecting does not guarantee cancellation or a refund; charges settle exactly from the signed receipt for work performed. Budget with max_tokens. stream_recovery_unavailable means the gateway does not yet support stream recovery: the request fails before inference starts; use stream: false instead. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

max_tokens.description: Budget generously (2000+) for reasoning models; thinking consumes tokens.

stream.description: Defaults to false. Set true explicitly for progressive OpenAI-compatible SSE with x-openmayhem-stream-mode: live.

stream_options.description: For streaming Chat Completions, set include_usage: true to receive a final usage chunk after the last delta and before [DONE]. Without this option, the usage chunk is omitted.

post.description: Requires the DECISIONS scope. Native Laya and the Flash JEV decision model evaluate application state against typed choice, score, or yes-or-no questions. Flash JEV may also use /decisions/flash-jev. These endpoints are synchronous, not OpenAI chat endpoints.

post.description: Requires the DECISIONS scope. Uses openmayhem/flash-jev, a platform-side typed-decision view of the canonical Qwen3.8 Flash-Next chat model. The request is charged at Flash-Next's current input and output token rates; there is no separate tariff. It asks Flash for probabilities in strict JSON and applies the same mechanical validation, bounded normalization (sum error at most 0.051), lexical tie break, weighted score, and request-sourced score legend used in the published evaluation. Confidence is a deterministic concentration display, not an independently calibrated forecast. No label-specific correction is applied. Invalid outputs return 502 after the signed model usage is charged; do not retry an ambiguous outcome as new work. Maximum input is 64,000 exact model tokens across state and questions, and 32,000 for state plus any single question. At most 64 named questions. The decision result is synchronous and does not stream.

questions.description: Map of question IDs to {type, instructions, criteria?}. type is noul, choice or score; choice criteria maps labels to descriptions, and score criteria is an ordered description array.

get.description: Requires BILLING_READ. Returns exact posted, reserved and available USD credit. Set include_rails=1 only when the FIAT, TNK and TAP split is needed.

workflow.description: ComfyUI API-format node graph matching the selected model's signed workflow policy. Start with its approved preset or a request prepared in Studio. Supported dimensions, nodes, model parts and LoRAs are contract-dependent; arbitrary graph changes are not accepted. LoRAs are configured in approved graph nodes, not a universal top-level loras field. Guide: https://openmayhem.ai/docs/media#workflow-api

input_files.description: Reference files required by the graph. Filenames must match its file references; accepted formats and limits depend on the model contract. File contents are base64, not local paths or LoRA weight uploads.

MinAttTier.name: X-Mayhem-Min-Att-Tier
MinAttTier.description: Minimum acceptable provider attestation tier. Unlike the catalog's exact attestation_tier filter, dispatch accepts this tier or any higher tier.

MinCtx.name: X-Mayhem-Min-Ctx
MinCtx.description: Text generation only. Minimum provider context capacity in tokens. The effective floor is never lower than the request's calculated input plus output requirement.

Quant.name: X-Mayhem-Quant
Quant.description: Require one canonical quantization bucket; matching is case-insensitive after normalization.

PreferProviders.name: X-Mayhem-Prefer-Providers
PreferProviders.description: Ordered, comma-separated provider public keys. This is a strict provider set: failover follows the listed order and does not fall back outside the set.

Hedge.name: X-Mayhem-Hedge
Hedge.description: Text generation only. Set to 1 to request hedged dispatch across eligible routes, or 0 to disable it. It cannot be combined with X-Mayhem-Prefer-Providers.

MinTokS.name: X-Mayhem-Min-Tok-S
MinTokS.description: Minimum sustained throughput in the endpoint's native measured unit per second. For text this is tokens per second; other endpoint families use their Core-defined native unit.

MaxWaitMs.name: X-Mayhem-Max-Wait-Ms
MaxWaitMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for an eligible provider admission. This is not the inference or asynchronous job runtime limit.

MaxRetailCostUsd.name: X-OpenMayhem-Max-Cost-Usd
MaxRetailCostUsd.description: Maximum retail USD hold for this request, with at most 6 decimal places. The request is rejected before spend if its worst case is higher. The stricter of this value and the API key's per-request cap wins. This never controls the private wholesale X-Mayhem-Max-Price-Au limit.

MaxInputPricePerMillionUsd.name: X-OpenMayhem-Max-Input-Price-Per-Million-Usd
MaxInputPricePerMillionUsd.description: Price ceiling for the model of this request. The request is refused before any credit hold with 403 price_ceiling_exceeded when the model's retail input price per one million tokens (pricing.prompt_per_million_au) is higher. The catalog filter max_input_price_per_million_usd takes the same number. It has no effect on a model without an input token rate.

MaxOutputPricePerMillionUsd.name: X-OpenMayhem-Max-Output-Price-Per-Million-Usd
MaxOutputPricePerMillionUsd.description: Price ceiling for the model of this request. The request is refused before any credit hold with 403 price_ceiling_exceeded when the model's retail output price per one million tokens (pricing.completion_per_million_au) is higher. The catalog filter max_output_price_per_million_usd takes the same number. It has no effect on a model without an output token rate.

MaxRepresentativeRequestPriceUsd.name: X-OpenMayhem-Max-Representative-Request-Price-Usd
MaxRepresentativeRequestPriceUsd.description: Price ceiling for the model of this request. The request is refused before any credit hold with 403 price_ceiling_exceeded when the retail price of the model's representative request (pricing.representative_request_au) is higher. The catalog filter max_representative_request_price_usd takes the same number. Use it for media, audio, video and workflow models.

EstimateId.name: X-OpenMayhem-Estimate
EstimateId.description: An estimate_id from POST /estimates. When present, it must match this key, model, body and routing controls; execution refuses a higher live maximum before holding credit.

bearerAuth.description: API key from the dashboard, format sk-om-v1-...

can_start.description: Read-only current route and whole-rail funding snapshot; nothing is reserved.

AttestationTier.description: T1 verified software report; T2 hardware device identity; T3 prompt-confidential hardware; T4 admin KYB identity. Higher is not synonymous with prompt confidentiality: inspect prompt_confidential separately.

UsdDecimal.description: Non-negative decimal USD string with at most 6 decimal places, parsed with exact fixed-point arithmetic.

CatalogUsdDecimal.description: Non-negative catalog price in USD with at most 18 decimal places, parsed with exact fixed-point arithmetic.

attestation_verification.description: Sanitized route policy readiness; internal reasons are never exposed.

representative_request_au.description: Retail price for one granularity block of every priced dimension. Use this unit-aware reference for cross-modality comparison; it is not a forecast for an arbitrary request.

request_contracts.description: Signed endpoint request contracts, including required attributes and allowed values. Inspect the contract for the selected endpoint rather than assuming all models accept the same parameters.

workflow.description: Signed workflow policy when available, including approved graph constraints and parts. Custom dimensions and LoRAs remain subject to this policy.

workflow_media.description: Validated media presentation metadata when available: supported controls, presets and approved selections used by Studio. This does not imply every model supports these features.

live_capacity_profiles.description: Current provider capacity profiles. A request must fit an eligible provider as well as the model contract; a catalog preset is not an availability guarantee.

registered_capacity_profiles.description: Registered capacity profiles, including providers that may not currently be available.

prompt_confidential.description: True when a live confidential route exists.

attestation_verification.description: Sanitized aggregate policy-readiness counts from Core.

routes.description: Sanitized registered route tuples. live marks routes currently dispatch-eligible; one tuple must satisfy all composed route filters.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor bound to the current filter and sort query.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Most errors. Failures before body parsing (missing/invalid key, oversized body) are the flat inner object without the error wrapper.

model.description: price_ceiling_exceeded only: the model of the request.

field.description: price_ceiling_exceeded only: the ceiling the price is above.

ceiling.description: price_ceiling_exceeded only: the ceiling in USD.

current.description: price_ceiling_exceeded only: the model's current retail price in that unit, as exact USD.

retail_cost_limit.description: Effective per-request retail USD cap after combining request and API-key limits.

routing.description: Validated routing controls frozen when the job was submitted.

ChatCompletion.description: OpenAI chat completion plus OpenMayhem billing fields.
